notes.title: V2.2.2.0 Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Dear Keeper,
    Mythag University will undergo facility maintenance on May 26 from 08:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8).
    After maintenance, you will need to log in again and update resources. Supplies will be sent via mail. For any questions, please contact the campus customer service center. Thank you for your understanding and support!

【Supplies】
Maintenance Compensation:  Silver*200, Pure Core*5

【Claim Conditions】
Claim period ends on June 9, 2025, at 09:00. Please remember to collect your supplies from the mailbox in time.

【Update Content】
1. Activity
[1.5th Anniversary Special Activity: Glimpse Beyond Sanctum]
●  "Glimpse Beyond Sanctum"
    ○ There is no time limit for the stages in "Glimpse Beyond Sanctum". The activity will automatically end after all "Bleak Tides" are completely eliminated.
    ○ "Glimpse Beyond Sanctum" contains 7 non-reenactable levels where you can directly challenge the "Bleak Tide." The first 3 levels are available on the first day of the activity, with 1 additional level unlocking every 3 days thereafter. Defeating the corresponding "Bleak Tide" will allow you to obtain the respective reward.
        ■ "Celestial Witness": Pure Core*1, Silver*50, EXP*240.
        ■ "Hollow Tremors": Mimetic Crystal*50, Silver*50, EXP*240.
        ■ "The Void Beckons": Aetheric Shard*30, Silver*50, EXP*240.
        ■ "Divine Whispers": Gnosis Fragment*2, Silver*50, EXP*240.
        ■ "Ritual Echoes": Thousand Faces Seal*80, Silver*50, EXP*240.
        ■ "Sovereign's Decree": Remembrance Quill*10, Silver*50, EXP*240.
        ■ "Unjust Devotion": Luminous Core*1, Silver*50, EXP*240.
    ○ Each "Bleak Tide" has a large number of clusters. Whenever any Keeper successfully challenges and defeats a "Bleak Tide," the "quantity of clusters" for that type of tide decreases by 1. When all clusters of a particular "Bleak Tide" are eliminated, the corresponding level will close and can no longer be challenged.
    ○ Each Keeper can challenge the Bleak Tide up to 20 times per day.
    ○ When challenging "Bleak Tide," if the Keeper or Awakened Awakener is below level 60, their attributes will automatically be raised to level 60.
    ○ Each level provides a special relic to aid the Keeper.
    ○ All stages must select a Combat Assist. Throughout the entire "Glimpse Beyond Sanctum" Activity, each Keeper can only provide one Combat Assist to you.
    ○ Keepers need to complete Investigation 2-9 at a minimum in order to participate in the "Glimpse Beyond Sanctum" activity.
    ○ "Glimpse Beyond Sanctum" will not allow difficulty selection and is quite challenging. Please make sure all of you are fully prepared in team cultivation, tactical strategies, and mental state!
 
[Guaranteed Activity: Awaken - The Unforgotten]
●  The following activity will be available for a limited time from May 26, 9:00 - June 9, 9:00!
    ○ Guaranteed Activity: Awaken "The Unforgotten":
        ■ Divided into 4 Realm Awakenings, each Realm Awakening can only perform 1 set of 5 consecutive Awakenings. Each 5-consecutive Awakening requires 980 Silver Prime and grants an additional "Gnosis Primer" ×1.
        ■ Awaken 5 times guaranteed to receive Random SSR Awakener *2 and Random SSR Wheel of Destiny *3
●  Chaos: Lily, 24, Ryker, Hameln, Tawil; Grace Through Pain, Aberrant Devour, Hour of Fortune, Eternal Requiem, Wheel Unseen.
●  Aequor: Tulu, Murphy, Miryam; Hymn of the Sovereign, Shrouded Birth, Power of the Pious.
●  Caro: Sorel, Salvador, Thais, Helot: Catena; By Rose Alone, Tablet of Scriptures, Merciful Nurturing, Drowning in Crimson.
●  Ultra: Daffodil, Wanda, Horla; Treasured Rarity, Queen's Edict, The Last Verse.
 
[Limited Time Event: Awaken - Kaleido Recollections]
●  Limited Time Event: Awaken "Kaleido Recollections":
    ○ The "Kaleido Recollections" card pool allows you to obtain the following random SSR Awakeners and random SSR Wheels of Destiny. The initial permanent Awakener in "Realms Research" will not appear in "Kaleido Recollections".
        ■ Chaos: Lily, 24, Ryker, Hameln, Tawil; Grace Through Pain, Aberrant Devour, Hour of Fortune, Eternal Requiem, Wheel Unseen.
        ■ Aequor: Tulu, Murphy, Miryam; Hymn of the Sovereign, Shrouded Birth, Power of the Pious.
        ■ Caro: Sorel, Salvador, Thais, Helot: Catena; By Rose Alone, Tablet of Scriptures, Merciful Nurturing, Drowning in Crimson.
        ■ Ultra: Daffodil, Wanda, Horla; Treasured Rarity, Queen's Edict, The Last Verse.
    ○ After every 2 consecutive Awakenings of the SSR Wheel of Destiny, the next Awakening will definitely result in an SSR Awakener.
 
[Character event: Castor]
●  From June 2, 9:00 - June 30, 9:00, the following Awakening Event will be available for a limited time!
    ○ Character Event Awakening "Obsidian Wings": Ultra realm warden awakener "Castor".
    ○ WoD Event Awakening "The Invictus": Wheel of Destiny "Unbearable Freedom".
    ○ Demo Activity "Divus: The Onyx Feather": Try out "Castor". You can receive "Silver" ×40, "Luminous Core" ×1.
●  The gameplay activity "Mirrored Prisoner" will be available from 9:00 on June 2 to 9:00 on June 16!
    ○ Completing the activity will offer a chance to obtain the limited Activity SR Wheel of Destiny "Lone Feather" and the limited Activity Avatar "By the Silver Key: Castor."
    ○ The "Book Set" series Selected Gift Box is available for a limited time during the Activity!
 
[Activity clone: Doll: Inferno]
●  From June 16, 9:00 - July 14, 9:00, the following Awakening Event will be available for a limited time!
    ○ Character Event Awakening "Absolute Prophet": Chaos Realm Chorus Awakener "Doll: Inferno".
    ○ WoD Event Awakening "Void Projection": Wheel of Destiny "Manikin of Oblivion".
    ○ Demo Activity: "Rotten Brain": Try out "Doll: Inferno". You can receive "Silver"*40, "Luminous Core"*1.
●  From June 16 at 9:00 to June 30 at 9:00, the "Half Step Away" gameplay activity will be temporarily available again!
    ○ Completing the activity will offer a chance to obtain the limited Activity SR Wheel of Destiny "Shepherd's Staff" and the limited Activity Avatar "By the Silver Key: Doll: Inferno."
    ○ The "Doll Components" series Selected Gift Box is available for a limited time during the activity!
 
[Mythag Events: Issue 18]
●  From June 2, 9:00 - June 30, 9:00, the following Mythag Events will be available for a limited time!
    ○ The Eighteenth "Gifts from Mythag"
        ■ Receive the bountiful reward of "Luminous Core" ×10 by logging in for 7 consecutive days during the event! Additional "Gifts from Mythag" upgrade rewards can be obtained by logging in for 28 consecutive days!
    ○ 18th Curriculum "Topic Records"
        ■ This issue's Premium Topics · Limited Avatars: "By the Silver Key: Juliette", "By the Silver Key: Brown".
        ■ This issue's Premium Topics · Limited Traphase Emotes: "Happy Mythag: Ryker: Please", "Happy Mythag: Doll: Can't Hear", "Peaceful Day: Alistair: Smile", "Peaceful Day: Salvador: Sure".
    ○ Season 18 "Mirrored Prisoner"
        ■ Limited Traphase Emote for this season: "Peaceful Day: Keeper · Are you there", "After School: Aurita · Face捏", "Happy Mythag: Ogier · Cheer", "Peaceful Day: Hameln · Helpless".
 
2. Goods
[New Player Reawaken Goods]
●  New "Argent Dawnlight" First-Time Limited Awakening. The Keeper has one free "Awaken 5 times" opportunity. Every "Awaken 5 times" will definitely obtain a random one from the 20 permanent Awakener in "Realms Research" (excluding previously Limited Awakeners already in "Realms Research"). If unsatisfied with the awakening result, you can continue to freely "Reawaken."
●  Now the "Realms Research" Awaken will be displayed after completing the "Argent Dawnlight" Awaken.
 
[Login and get 100 pulls]
●  During May 26, 9:00 - June 9, 9:00, log in for a total of 7 days to receive the bountiful reward of "Pure Core" ×100 and "Basic Skin Voucher (Phase 1)" ×1!
 
[1.5 Anniversary: Annihilated Rebirth]
●  Log in daily between May 26, 9:00 and June 30, 9:00 to obtain the SSR Wheel of Destiny "Annihilated Rebirth," with a maximum of 16 "Annihilated Rebirth" available to claim!
    ○ Attribute: Aliemus Regen Level
    ○ Effect: After the wielder releases Exalt, increases the Base DMG of Exalt by 7/8/9/10%, and increases Shield and HP Healing by 2/3/4/5%. Stacks up to 5 times. After completing an Explore, increases the Affinity gained by the wielder by 10/15/20/25%.
 
[Daily Free Gift Available]
●  After maintenance, the Keeper can receive a free Gift Box daily by logging in at the "Store - Selected Gift Box" tab.
 
[Shard Overflow and SSR Wheel of Destiny Disassembly Added]
●  Obtain Awakener Shard overflow conversion from Gnosis Fragment*1 to Gnosis Fragment*3 + Refined Gnosis Fragment*1.
●  The reward from disassembling an SSR Wheel of Destiny has been upgraded from Gnosis Fragment*1 to Gnosis Fragment*3 + Refined Gnosis Fragment*1.
●  For the previous Awakener Shard overflow and SSR Wheel of Destiny disassembly, we will retroactively issue the corresponding Gnosis Fragments and Refined Gnosis Fragments within 48 hours after the update.
 
[In-Sheath Supply Upgrade]
●  After buying the "Selected Gift Box" and "In-Sheath Supply", you can receive an additional 30 "Remembrance Quills" via daily mail for 30 days.
●  For Keepers who previously purchased "In-Sheath Supply" and received Menophin via daily emails, we will send the corresponding quantity of "Remembrance Quill" via email within 48 hours after the update. Please check your inbox.
●  At the same time, the quantity of "Remembrance Quill" rewards in Curriculum has also increased accordingly: the "Remembrance Quill" reward quantity for Basic Topics at Level 50 increases from 50 to 100, and the "Remembrance Quill" reward quantity for Advanced Topics at Level 50 increases from 150 to 300.
●  For Keepers who previously received the 50-level "Remembrance Quill" Reward from past and this issue's Curriculum, we will send the corresponding quantity of "Remembrance Quills" via email within 48 hours after the update. Please check your inbox.
 
[Gifts from Mythag Upgrade]
●  After the update on June 2 at 9:00, the original 7-day login "Gifts from Mythag" reward has been upgraded to a total of 28 days of cumulative login rewards. The first 7 days' login rewards remain unchanged, and subsequent logins will add various new resource rewards.
 
[Alumni Donation Fund Upgrade]
●  The Silver Prime Donation reward is increased by 1 Refined Gnosis Primer, 1 Aetheric Stone, a Formless One's Gift Card, and the quantity of Remembrance Quill is doubled.
●  The Keeper who has already received the corresponding donation reward will have it retroactively sent to their email after maintenance.
 
[First Recharge Reset with Double Rewards]
●  To celebrate the 1.5th anniversary, the first Prime Extraction will reset the opportunity to receive an equal amount of Silver after this update. Please pay attention.
 
[Silverglow Journey: Beginner's Special Offer]
●  The Keeper will receive the "Silverglow: Journey's Start - Beginner's Special Offer" after clearing Investigation 1-2 and completing the investigation.
●  The gift package is time-limited for 24 hours. Keepers can purchase it directly on the pop-up page or buy it within the "Time-Limited Supervalue Bundle" on the homepage within 24 hours after the pop-up.
 
3. Content
[Psyche Deepdive: Liz]
●  New chapter "Passion to Dust" for Psyche Deepdive by Liz!
    ○ Spin, spin, the black swan follows her dance steps. The ballet hall she has built within her heart cannot be disturbed or shaken by any vulgar words.
●  Clear the mission to unlock the new Posse "Black Swan’s Dance."
    ○ Posse Effect: Choose an Awakener, temporarily increasing their Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG by 15%, and gain 15 points of Aliemus. If Liz is in the team, place one "Corrupted Flames" with the "Consumes" effect into your hand.
 
[Collection: Phonograph Unlocked]
●  The "Collection" Phonograph module is now available!
    ○ Open time: After 9:00 on May 26
●  The Keeper can enjoy unlocked original music in the "Phonograph."
    ○ Clearing the ordinary mode unlocks approximately 1/3 of the tracks in the corresponding chapter's original sound collection.
    ○ Clearing the Hard mode unlocks approximately 1/3 of the tracks in the corresponding chapter's original sound collection.
    ○ Use "Reality Verge" to unlock the remaining tracks.
 
[Dreamscape: Castor]
●  New chapter "Dreamscape: Castor - Beyond the Skies · Part 1"!
    ○ Unlock time: After June 2, 9:00 AM
    ○ This is a song of birds singing to the sky. What is the outside world really like? Is there an end to the distant horizon? Are there loyal knights and beautiful princesses, boundless grasslands and valiant steeds? Go, go see for yourself, and prepare to set out today.
●  After clearing, you can unlock the new Posse "Derison of Destiny".
    ○ Temporary Strong Effect + 25%, draw 2 cards with the lowest Arithmetica Cost from the draw pile. If Castor is in the team, grant him 15 points of Aliemus.
 
[Premium Skin Launch: Silver Spine Skin]
●  "Store: Illusion Outfit Order" is now available!
    ○ The following "Basic Skin (Phase 1)" is permanently available!
        ■ "Spinning Marionette", price is Silver Prime ×680.
        ■ "Dissociative Symphony", price is Silver Prime ×680.
        ■ "Her Little Pastime", price is Silver Prime ×680.
        ■ "Divine Benediction", price is Silver Prime ×680.
        ■ You can use the Basic Skin Voucher (Phase 1) to redeem the above skins from May 26, 9:00 to June 9, 9:00. The original price will be restored after the activity ends.
    ○ From May 26, 9:00 - June 9, 9:00, Keepers can accumulate "Basic Skin Voucher (Phase 1)" ×5.
        ■ Get 1 Basic Skin Voucher (Phase 1) by logging in for 7 consecutive days.
        ■ Participate in "1.5th Anniversary Special Activity: Glimpse Beyond Sanctum" and defeat "Bleak Tide" a total of 30 times, obtain "Basic Skin Voucher (Phase 1)" ×1
        ■ During the activity, first-time participants in "The Unforgotten" Awakening will receive a "Basic Skin Voucher (Phase 1)" ×1.
        ■ Participate in the DC Community Activity during the event period to send blessings to Morimens 1.5th Anniversary, and you can obtain "Basic Skin Voucher (Phase 1)" ×1.
        ■ On the 1.5th Anniversary (5/30), log in to receive "Basic Skin Voucher (Phase 1)" ×1 via email.
 
4. Gameplay
[General]
●  Posse Adjustment:
    ○ The base Keyflare energy cap of the "Non-Chaos Realm" is increased to 2000, and a second Posse "Dust-Laden Memories" can be released each turn.
"Forgotten Memories": Choose 1 from 3 random unlocked Posse to release. Each Posse can only be chosen once during exploration.
    ○ When releasing the Posse for the second time under "Chaos Realm," it no longer releases "Chaos Memories," but instead releases "Unforgotten Twilight."
"Unforgotten Twilight": Choose 1 unlocked Posse to Release, and make it take effect 2 times. Each Posse can only be chosen once during exploration.
●  Deep sea realm:
    ○ At the end of the turn, if in the Surging Tides state, 1 Tentacle will be generated at the start of the next turn.
    ○ When Tentacles are overflowing, the Tentacle Limit is increased by 1, and the number of Tentacle Overflow times needed for the next Tentacle Limit increase is also increased by 1. Through this effect, the Tentacle Limit can be increased by a maximum of 5.
●  Astral Reign:
    ○ Prism Lens: The halved value of the permanent Counter is increased from 500% HP to 750% HP, with the cap value remaining unchanged.
    ○ Prism Lens: After awakening an Awakener, at the end of its Turn, gain 25% of the current permanent Counter as Temporary Counter. At the end of an Enemy's Turn, additionally trigger 25% Poison on all enemies.
    ○ Cone of Destiny Light: All Astral Reign levels no longer have a turn limit, but you can still obtain the "Cone of Destiny Light" on Turn 15!
 
[Awakener]
●  Lotan
    ○ Soulforge Aptitude: Lotan's Command Cards deal 50%-100% increased Base DMG. For each instance of DMG dealt by Lotan, Temporary Final DMG increases by 2%, up to a maximum of 10%~20%.
●  Ogier
    ○ Dimensional Image · Ogier: "Strike" will also trigger the Effect of Shield and STR enhancement, but it can still only be triggered once per Turn.
    ○ Soulforge Aptitude: Ogier's Shield Boost is increased by 5%-15%. Each time Exalt is released, the shield generated in this battle additionally increases DEF by 1%.
●  Doll
    ○ Soulforge Aptitude: The Heal effect from Doll's Aliemus and Exalt is increased by 5%-15%. For each additional Chaos Awakener in the team, this effect increases by an additional 5%.
●  Ramona & Ramona: Timeworn
    ○ Ramona-Enlighten 1-Confused Start: New Queen's Sword DMG times +1.
    ○ Ramona-Enlighten 3-Precious Bond: Remove +1 Queen's Sword DMG times. New: After releasing the Posse, Ramona gains a Temporary Crit. Rate increase of 50%.
    ○ Soulforge Aptitude: Ramona's Keyflare Regen is increased by 5%-15%. Obtain 50-150% of Ramona's Keyflare Regen as Keyflare at the start of battle.
●  Aigis
    ○ Soulforge Aptitude: After playing the first Command Card each turn, obtain 50%-100% Keyflare Regen as Keyflare.
●  Erica
    ○ Electromagnetic Blast: The temporary Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG Buff effect from the Talent "External Power Source" is applied to this damage.
    ○ Function Overload: The number of DMG instances increased from X+1 to X+2.
    ○ Mechanical Armament - Unleash: Temporary STR increased by 33%.
    ○ Soulforge Aptitude: At the start of battle, obtain 5%-15% of Erica's ATK as STR and 1%-3% of DEF as Alert.
 
[Enemy]
●  Reduced enemy HP and DMG in Chapter 8-9 of the ordinary difficulty in "Faded Legacy". HP is reduced by approximately 30%, and DMG is reduced by approximately 10%.
●  Reduced the HP of elite and leader enemies with "Ashes of the Past."
●  Reduced the HP and DMG of enemies "Doll: Inferno" and "B-68".
●  Reduced the shield value obtained by enemies "Missing Person" and "Unable to Communicate" when players play non-Command Cards.
●  Reduced the HP of the enemy "Sleeping Master".
●  Reduced the DMG of enemy "Water Lily" Exalt "Passage of the Ego".
●  Adjusted "Sweet Demon"'s "Whip of Madness" basic attack times and DMG. DMG is reduced by 50%, and basic attack times are increased from 2 to 3.
●  Increased the HP of "Apostle of the Sea".
●  The "Link Breaker" enemy's "Chains" card now has consumes added after awakening.
●  Adjusted the "Whale Leap" attack pattern. Now it will be more aggressive and deal more DMG in Phase 1.
●  Increased the HP of the "Bursting Pustule" summoned by "Sludge Flower" after awakening, and reduced its DMG.
●  Adjusted the HP ratio of "Stone Eye," "Whale Jump," "24," "Rogue Walker," "Convex Moon Maiden," "Bloodthirsty Patient," "Water Lily," "Chain Breaker," "Blossom of Sludge," "Sweet Demon," "Revenge Great Blade," "Skull-Huntress," "Scarlet," "Deep Dweller," "Imaginary Blade," "Apostle of the Sea," and "Wonder Mage" before and after awakening, changing it from 1:1 to 1:1.5, with total HP remaining unchanged.
 
5. System
[New Player Tutorial Process Optimization]
●  Add a tutorial process and instructions before "Investigation Level" 1-2
 
[English Localization Optimization]
●  Battle names and battle effect types are optimized by AI translation into official text
 
[Regression Chronicle]
●  Return Event "Recursive Archives" has been activated!
    ○ Players who return after 7-14 days of inactivity can receive generous rewards by completing 5 days of login tasks, and purchasing the pass grants additional rewards.
●  Return Event "Ouroboros Codex" has been activated
    ○ Players who have not logged in for more than 14 days can receive generous rewards by completing 10 consecutive login tasks. Purchasing the Journey will grant additional rewards.
 
[Anniversary Wheel of Destiny: Redeem]
●  Now you can use Sedimentation to redeem the Anniversary Wheel of Destiny "Heart of Silver" in the "Sedimentation Exchange".
 
[Awakener Demo]
●  The Limited Awakener Demo is now permanently available in "Intermission Study: Awakener Demo." Keepers can also go directly to this Awakener Demo from the Limited Character Activity Awaken interface.
 
[Moonphase Vigil]
●  Optimized the interface for "Moonphase Vigil" and the effect of receiving rewards upon login after purchase
 
[Dorm: Dynamic Effect Boost]
●  Enhanced the dynamic effect of the home screen background.
 
[Awaken]
●  A banner image has been added for each Character Event Awakening at the "Awaken" entry on the home page.
 
[Overview of Awakener and Wheel of Destiny Gameplay]
●  You can now view the overview of gameplay features for the current limited-time Awakener in Character Event Awakening.
●  You can now view the overview of the current limited Wheel of Destiny mode and the recommended equipment for Awakener in the Wheel of Destiny Event Awakening.
 
[New Unlock Hint]
●  The following content adds a new unlock hint when unlocked
    ○ "Manual"
    ○ "Daily Quest"
    ○ "Dissolution Ruins: Gold Coupon Search / Preparation and Refinement"
 
[Enhance Hint]
●  Enhanced the hint effect when unlocking features. Now there are additional unlock interface dynamic effects and simple text hints.
●  Added and updated pop-up hints for some function unlocks. When entering a function interface for the first time, a "?" hint will pop up, with additional information explanations added to some interfaces.
●  When entering each cultivation interface in the Awakener Details for the first time, an illustrated introduction will pop up to help Keepers better understand the cultivation operations.
●  When the "Investigation" fails for the first time or is exited voluntarily, a hint pop-up will be added to guide the Keeper to obtain various materials through interlude exercises to make the Awakener stronger.
●  During the launch period of new activities such as Character Event Awakening and Character Events, a hint will pop up when the Keeper logs in for the first time to the home page.
●  Provides guidance for the first Awaken, Interlude - Demo, Awakener Upgrade, Lineup, first trigger of Emergency Gnosis, first trigger of Death Resistance, and first trigger of Orison.
 
[Traphase]
●  Adjusted the description of the Taunt effect; this has no impact on the current effect. Updated description: The opponent prioritizes attacking you, and when choosing a single target, the opponent can only select the Awakener with Taunt. When obtaining Taunt, it removes Taunt from other friendly units.
 
6. Issue Repair
●  Fixed an issue where, under the Chaos Realm mechanics, certain Faded Legacy levels would randomly grant Astral Reign relics.
●  Fixed an issue where the "Count" description text for Helot: Catena's Skill "Crimson Shackles" after being retrieved from Ultra Space did not match its actual Effect.
●  Fixed an issue where the power multiplier buff obtained by releasing the Posse after the Awakener "Tawil"'s Skill "Master of Omniscient Verity" changed to "Predetermined Strike" would still be inherited even when switching to other Skill cards.
●  Fixed an issue where the enemy Mareel Glow's effect incorrectly placed the Symptom: Madness into the player's hand instead of onto them.
●  Fixed an issue where a story event was present in pursuit 2-3 of the Hard mode Investigation: Astral Reign.
●  Fixed an issue where Ryker's Dimensional Image was ineffective against "Octahedron Dice" and "Shining Octahedron Die".
    ○ Fixed an issue where the Dissolution text on Corposant's communicator was not displayed clearly.
    ○ Optimized the timing for obtaining "Light Cone Boundary," which will now take priority over placing Ultra Space Cards during Ultra Rounds.
    ○ The Collection has updated Corposant's character information.
    ○ Fixed typo issues in Chapter 1 of Faded Legacy: "East District's Enigma".
    ○ Fixed the font display error for the avatar "By the Silver Key: Salvador".

notes.title: 1.5th Anniversary Benefits Preview
notes.content:
【1.5-year Mythag School Celebration • Benefits Preview】
The speech at the Silver Key Award Ceremony is still ringing in our ears: "Becoming an investigator at Mythag University means spending the rest of your life amidst death and madness...."
1.5 years, 548 days and nights, thank you Keeper for always standing firmly with Mythag, walking together on the abyss road against Dissolution💗

⭐The carefully prepared 1.5-year anniversary celebration is about to meet you. We have prepared many wonderful programs and gifts for the keepers! We wish you all a happy time~

notes.title: 2.2.0.0 Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Dear Keeper,
    Mythag University will undergo facility maintenance on April 7 from 08:00 to 12:00 (UTC+8).
    After maintenance, you will need to log in again and update resources. Supplies will be sent via mail. For any questions, please contact the campus customer service center. Thank you for your understanding and support!
   
【Supplies】
Maintenance Compensation: Silver*200, Pure Core*5
 
【Claim Conditions】
Claim period ends on April 21 2025, at 09:00. Please remember to collect your supplies from the mailbox.
 
【Update Content】
1. Events
【Character Event: Clementine】
● From April 7, 9:00 to May 5, 9:00, the following events will be available for a limited time!
    ○ Character Event Awakening "Heart Healer": Ultra Realm Support Awakener "Clementine".
    ○ Wheel of Destiny Event Awakening "Painful Memories": Wheel of Destiny "Hidden Pain".
    ○ Trial Event "Hypnotic Bug": Try "Clementine". Rewards: "Silver Core" ×40, "Luminous Core" ×1.
● Gameplay Event "Buried Under Memories" will be available from April 7, 9:00 to April 21, 9:00!
    ○ Strategy Event rewards include limited SR Wheel of Destiny "Hypnotic Pendulum" and limited avatar "In the Name of Silver Key: Clementine".
    ○ Limited-time sale of "Mad Prescription" series gift boxes during the event!

【Event Reprint: "24"】
● From April 21, 9:00 to May 19, 9:00, the following awakening events will be available for a limited time!
    ○ Character Event Awakening Reprint "As Myself": Chaos Realm Damage Awakener "24".
    ○ Wheel of Destiny Event Awakening Reprint "Symbiotic Illusion": Wheel of Destiny "Aberrant Recoil".
    ○ Trial Event Reprint "Split Patient: Chaos", "Split Patient: Deep Sea", "Split Patient: Caro", "Split Patient: Ultra": Try "24". Rewards for each trial: "Silver Core" ×40, "Luminous Core" ×1.
● From April 21, 9:00 to May 5, 9:00, the "Multiple Healing" gameplay event reprint will be available for a limited time!
    ○ Strategy Event rewards include limited SR Wheel of Destiny "Silver Cod's Determination" and limited avatar "In the Name of Silver Key: 24".
    ○ Free unlock of "Special Operation: Serene Fission" during the event!
    ○ Limited-time sale of "Dissociation Therapy" series gift boxes during the event!

【Academy Event: 16th Term】
● From April 7, 9:00 to May 5, 9:00, the following academy events will be available for a limited time!
● 16th Term "Academy Gifts"
    ○ Log in for 7 days during the event to receive "Luminous Core" ×10 as a reward!
● 16th Term "Assignment Records"
    ○ Core Assignment Limited Avatar: "In the Name of Silver Key: Alistair", "In the Name of Silver Key: Albino".
    ○ Core Assignment Limited Battle Emotes: "Happy Mythag: Thais - Chin Rest", "Happy Mythag: Dexter - Cheers", "Campus Life: Sylvia - Taking Medicine", "Campus Life: William - Knocking Blackboard".
● 16th Season "Soul Journey"
    ○ Season Limited Battle Emotes: "Unhappy Mythag: Sanga - What Do You Say", "Happy Mythag: Uvhash - Strength", "Happy Mythag: Lotan - Joy", "Peaceful Day: Erica - Goodbye".

2. Investigation
【Investigation Operation: Transformation】
● Empty corridors, layered doors, you follow the familiar blonde figure into the unknown sanatorium. Listen, the alarm rings again, it's the building's feedback to you—the prey has fallen into the net, the mastermind is about to gently close the net.
● Part 2 "Moment of Star Alignment" Chapter 2 "Transformation" will be gradually opened soon!
    ○ Part 1: April 7.
    ○ Part 2: April 10.
    ○ Part 3: April 14.
● Unlock the new Key Command "Special Treatment" after clearing all stages.
    ○ Key Command Effect: Restore 54 HP, gain 16 Strength. If Clementine is in the team, her next command card this turn will have increased damage, shield, HP recovery, Aliemus gain, and Silver Key energy gain by 1.

3. Battle
【Awakener】
● Jenkin
    ○ Spirit Plasticity: The first 10 "Brown Attack" cards played each turn do not add Arithmetica Harmony. Jenkin's damage increases by 20-60% of attack power.
    ○ Gotcha!: "Ultimate Assemble" now shuffles a "Mouse Swarm Impact" card dealing X+10 damage into the draw pile top.
    ○ Brown Attack: No longer requires teleportation to deal damage to all enemies, teleportation effect adjusted to enjoy 1x Strength bonus.
    ○ Assembling Mice: Now shuffles "Brown Attack" or "Mouse Swarm Impact" into the draw pile top, the shuffled Mouse Swarm Impact deals "X+4" damage.
    ○ Mouse Swarm Impact: Arithmetica cost reduced from 2 to 1, gains "Retain".
Jenkin
● "24"
    ○ Spirit Plasticity: "24" base damage increases by 20-50%, final damage against "The Sculptors" enemies increases by 15-35%.

【Wheel of Destiny】
● "Aberrant Recoil": Equip base Aliemus burst damage increased from 35% to 60%.

【Key Command】
● "Void Plague": Changed from "If target HP is below 25%, trigger 50% poison" to "For each 1% HP lost by the enemy, trigger 1% poison, up to 50%".

【Others】
● Added "Retain" effect to all "Gnosis Awakening", now not only Silver Key Awakening in Star Chapter grants "Retain".
● Supplemented "Deep Sea Symbiosis" effect description: For each Chaos Awakener in the team, base tentacle damage increases by 0.01% of max HP, no impact on actual effect.

4. Traphase
【Wheel of Destiny】
● Happy Magic Show: Card draw reduced from 2 to 1.

5. General
【Awakener Rewind】
● "Time Origin" can now be used on special Awakeners!
    ○ Using "Time Origin" on special Awakeners will not open "Enlighten Rewind" and "Black Pool Return".
● "Rewind" now splits "Development Rewind" return Enlighten development effect into "Enlighten Rewind", and both "Development Rewind" and "Enlighten Rewind" can be used simultaneously!
    ○ "Enlighten Rewind" resets Enlighten level cap and returns consumed materials.
● After "Development Rewind" or "Enlighten Rewind", "Black Pool Return" cannot be performed.
● Special Awakeners include all limited Awakeners, Ramona, Ramona-loop, Ogier, Lotan, Doll, Aigis, Aurita, Erica.
● After this update, 1 "Time Origin" will be automatically issued, please check your inventory.

【Investigation Entry Adjustment】
● Adjusted special plot entry, now view Miryam plot "Desecration" through "Dreamscape" entry, view "Reverse Turn" collaboration plot through new "Multi-dimensional Connection" entry.

6. Optimization and Bug Fixes
● Fixed issue where Awakener "Uvhash" still affected by monster "Awakener Tulu" seal effect after Gnosis Awakening.
● Fixed issue where Awakener "Ogier" shield strength boost from "Dimensional Image" in Star Chapter stages not being 50%.
● Fixed issue where boost cards "Silver Key Dawn", "Silver Key Glow" etc. considered as using Arithmetica cost ≤2 cards when Key Command "Fourth Movement" is activated.
● Fixed issue where Wheel of Destiny "Breaking the Chain" carrier could gain critical rate boost from non-"Direct Use Embryo" methods.
● After core assignments expire, all limited-time cards in Traphase will no longer be removed from the lineup.
● Fixed issue where Star Chapter stage progress not displayed.
● Optimized appearance of Star Chapter hard stage entry to distinguish from normal difficulty.
● Fixed issue where rewards claimed in "Assignment Records" not displayed.
● Fixed issue in Korean translation, Awakener - Awakening Records, "Miryam" side plot text display anomaly.
● Fixed issue where Star Chapter black sigil icon details incorrectly displayed "Forgotten Chapter" icon.
● Fixed issue where some "Awakener" skill interface not displaying Arithmetica cost.
● Fixed issue where reward prompt window not popping up after failing to claim monthly card.
● Fixed issue where Chrono Pendulum "Lost" damage boost value incorrectly set to 0.
● Fixed issue where "Communicator" red dot present when not unlocked.
● Fixed issue where Resonance Particle consumption in Investigation Operation Chapter 7 "River of Desire" "Illusory Murmurs" set to 0.

notes.title: V2.0.0.0 Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Dear Keeper,
    The Mythag University Administration Office will conduct facility repairs on January 13th from 08:00 to 12:00. After this maintenance, the old version of the client will no longer be usable. Keepers need to visit the official website or app store to install the latest version to continue logging in. (The latest version is already available for download on the store and website, so you can update in advance or follow the prompts from the old client after maintenance starts.) Good luck with your investigations!
 
【Supply Materials】
 Maintenance Compensation: Silver *1000
  
【Claim Conditions】
Claim period ends on January 27, 2025, at 09:00. Please remember to collect your supplies from the mailbox in time.
  
【Update Content】
1.Events
【Special Event: Usacat Rules】
● From January 24th 9:00 to February 5th 9:00, the "Usacat Rules" event will be open for a limited time!
● As the festival approaches, everyone is focused on the preparations, unaware of the black patches creeping in the corners. A small prisoner has turned into liquid and escaped the cage. As the dimensional fissures flicker, black furballs begin to split... a sea of black cats is engulfing the campus! You initially wanted to ignore it and leave it to the administration, but seeing that they drop Silver and Golden Rose, you changed your mind.
    ○ Different challenge stages open daily, each with different realm lineup requirements.
    ○  January 24th~January 29th: Chaos / Deep Sea / Caro / Ultra / Unlimited / Unlimited
    ○  January 30th~February 4th: Chaos Deep Sea / Caro Ultra / Chaos Caro / Deep Sea Ultra / Chaos Ultra / Caro Deep Sea
    ○  Each Awaker can only participate once per stage per day. No assist usage, and challenges do not consume Menophin.
    ○ Each completed stage rewards "Pure Core" ×1, "Silver" ×88.
    ○ Each stage has three difficulty levels, with additional rewards of 88888 / 188888 / 288888 Golden Rose for levels 30 / 50 / 70.
● During the event, limited-time chain packs "Gift of Soul Resonance" and "Gift of Fate" will be available!
  
【Event Re-run: Lily】
● From January 13th 9:00 to February 10th 9:00, the "Lily" Awaker event will be open for a limited time!
    ○ Character event re-run "Flower Unstained": Chaos realm defense-type Awaker "Lily".
    ○ Wheel of Destiny event re-run "Pure White Hope": Wheel of Destiny "Crossing Pain".
    ○ Trial event re-run "Flower in the Slime": Try "Lily". Rewards include "Silver" *40, "Lumen Core" *1.
● From January 13th 9:00 to January 27th 9:00, the "Magic of Stories" event will be open for a limited time!
    ○ Strategy event rewards include limited SR Wheel of Destiny "35mm Magic" and limited avatar "In the Name of Silver Key: Lily".
    ○ During the event, "Special Operation: Magic of Stories" will be unlocked for free!
    ○ During the event, the "Story Film" series selected gift boxes will be available for a limited time!
  
【Event Re-run: Sorel】
● From January 27th 9:00 to February 24th 9:00, the "Sorel" Awaker event will be open for a limited time!
    ○ Character event re-run "High Cup Feast": Caro realm damage-type Awaker "Sorel".
    ○ Wheel of Destiny event re-run "Blood Overflow": Wheel of Destiny "In the Name of Rose".
    ○ Trial event re-run "Red Lady": Try "Sorel". Rewards include "Silver" *40, "Lumen Core" *1.
● From January 27th 9:00 to February 10th 9:00, the "With the Rose Book" event will be open for a limited time!
    ○ Strategy event rewards include limited SR Wheel of Destiny "Million Loving Gaze" and limited avatar "In the Name of Silver Key: Sorel".
    ○ During the event, "Special Operation: Rose Praise" will be unlocked for free!
    ○ During the event, the "Mass" series selected gift boxes will be available for a limited time!
  
2.New Content
【The Wandering: Coronation Day】
● "The Wandering" adds a new chapter "Coronation Day"!
    ○  Glory, reverence, and infinite power, the king's position is supreme. All it takes to ascend the throne is to be chosen by the gods. But what price will be paid for all this?
● After clearing, unlock the new Posse "Blessing of the Stars".
    ○  Posse Effect: Choose "Slumber" or "Awake".
    ○  Slumber: Gain 48 shield points, gain 1 layer of "Star Blessing", max 5 layers, not cleared after battle.
    ○  Awake: All Awakers gain 8 Aliemus. Consume all "Star Blessing" layers and gain Arithmetica equal to the consumed layers. If the current realm is "Deep Sea", additionally generate temporary tentacles equal to the consumed layers.
 
【Silver Communication: New Messages】
● After clearing all chapters of current operations, special operations, The Wandering, and Dreamscape, Awakers or other characters may communicate with you about recent events via Silver Communication.
● Note that for chapters previously cleared, you need to complete the last stage of the chapter again after the update to trigger this Silver Communication.
 
3.Battle
【Realm Mix】
● Lineups will now allow any 2 different realms to coexist, giving you the opportunity to use Deep Sea, Caro, and Ultra realms in one team! The talents of each realm have been adjusted to better explain the new mixed realm rules. Now, as long as there is one Awaker from a realm in the team, that realm's talent will be activated.
● Note that while the descriptions may seem different, the effects of the original Chaos and Ultra realms remain largely unchanged after the update, while the original Caro and Deep Sea mechanisms have been enhanced.
● Chaos·Cosmic Phenomena
    ○  Silver Key Resonance: Gain 250 S-energy at the end of each turn. After using a Posse, all Awakers gain 5 Aliemus. You can use 2 Posses per turn, and the second Posse in a single turn will be chosen from other unlocked Posses, which cannot be chosen again in this exploration.
    ○  Creation of Phenomena: If the Keeper's level is 45 or higher, discover 1 Silver Relic at the start of exploration.
    ○  Chaos Mastery: For each point of realm mastery in the team, the additional Aliemus gained by all Awakers after using a Posse increases by 0.05 points.
    ○  Born to Die: Death resistance +100%.
    ○  Chaos Symbiosis: When mixed with other realms, "Silver Key Resonance", "Creation of Phenomena", and "Chaos Mastery" are disabled, and the pure talent effect of the other realm is always triggered, gaining different realm symbiosis effects based on the realm.
■ Deep Sea Symbiosis: At the start of battle, for each Chaos Awaker in the team, increase base tentacle damage by 1% of max HP. After Chaos Awakers use Aliemus Burst, gain 1 layer of Tentacle Assembly and all Deep Sea Awakers gain 10 Aliemus.
■ Caro Symbiosis: At the end of each turn, for each Chaos Awaker in the team, accumulate 2% of max HP in the Crimson Furnace. After Chaos Awakers use Aliemus Burst, Embryo Fusion +25%.
■ Ultra Symbiosis: At the start of battle, for each Chaos Awaker in the team, permanently increase ally power by 1% of max HP and reduce all enemies' power by 0.5% of max HP, while increasing all Ultra Awakers' critical damage by 10%.
  
● Deep Sea·Abyssal Touch
    ○ Tentacle Dominion: At the start of battle, generate 1 tentacle. Tentacles automatically attack front-row enemies at the end of each turn.
    ○ Tentacle Stance: Switch tentacle stance once per turn. Starts in the basic "Surge" stance. Switching to "Calm Sea" immediately grants a shield equal to 8% of max HP, and each tentacle attack grants a shield equal to 0.2% of max HP, but tentacle damage is reduced to 50% for that turn. Switching to "Raging Waves" increases tentacle damage to 125% for that turn, and after dealing active damage, one tentacle attacks the target for 50% tentacle damage, but one tentacle is lost at the end of the turn.
    ○ Tentacle Assembly: After Awakers use Aliemus Burst, gain 1 layer of Tentacle Assembly. At the end of each turn, for each layer of Tentacle Assembly, one tentacle attacks front-row enemies, then clears Tentacle Assembly.
    ○ Tentacle Crit: Tentacles can crit, with initial crit rate and crit damage equal to 50% of all Awakers' crit rate and crit damage combined upon entering the stage. For each Awaker in the stage, gain 1% crit rate and crit damage, increasing tentacle crit rate and crit damage by 0.25%.
    ○ Deep Sea Mastery: For each point of realm mastery in the team, after Awakers use Aliemus Burst, there is a 0.25% chance to gain an additional layer of Tentacle Assembly at the end of the turn. If the probability exceeds 100%, gain multiple layers. Switching to "Calm Sea" immediately increases the shield gained by 0.01% of max HP, and the tentacle damage triggered by active damage in "Raging Waves" increases by 0.02%.
    ○ Pure Deep Sea: If the team consists only of Deep Sea Awakers, the Deep Sea Mastery attribute effect is doubled, and the number of tentacles generated at the start of battle is doubled.
  
● Caro·Crimson Sacrifice
    ○  Embryo Fusion: At the start of each turn, Embryo Fusion +30%, increasing with lower HP, up to 100%. At 100%, place 1 "Embryo" in hand. "Embryo" can be used directly to provide 30 Aliemus to an Awaker and gain 10% temporary crit rate.
    ○ Crimson Furnace: After battle, accumulate 5% of max HP in the Crimson Furnace, which can be used to restore HP, up to 25% of max HP. If "Embryo" is not used by the end of the battle, it is automatically consumed and accumulates 5% of max HP in the Crimson Furnace.
    ○  Embryo Devour: Caro Awakers' Aliemus Burst has a "Devour" effect, attempting to consume "Embryo" when used. If successful, the "Devour" effect is triggered. The first "Devour" triggered each turn grants a shield equal to 4% of max HP and temporary power equal to 2% of max HP, increasing with lower HP, up to 100%.
    ○  Caro Mastery: For each point of realm mastery in the team, the first "Devour" triggered each turn grants an additional shield equal to 0.01% of max HP and temporary power equal to 0.005% of max HP, increasing with lower HP, up to 100%.
    ○ Pure Caro: If the team consists only of Caro Awakers, the Caro Mastery attribute effect is doubled, and the base accumulation of the Crimson Furnace at the end of the battle is doubled.
  
● Ultra·Dimensional Leap
    ○ Ultra Space: After playing the first command card each turn, place its original temporary copy into Ultra Space. When Ultra Space reaches its limit, gain an extra Ultra Turn.
    ○ Ultra Turn: During an Ultra Turn, place all cards in Ultra Space into hand instead of drawing cards. Damage, shield, HP recovery, S-energy, Aliemus, power changes, poison, counter, and bleeding effects are halved during Ultra Turn.
    ○ Annihilation: Once per turn, remove the leftmost card in Ultra Space and place 1 "Inspiration" in hand.
    ○ Command Leap: Some command cards of Ultra Awakers have a "Leap" effect, triggering the "Leap" effect when played into Ultra Space or during an Ultra Turn.
    ○ Ultra Mastery: For each point of realm mastery in the team, there is a 0.125% chance to gain 1 "Inspiration" at the start of each turn. If the probability exceeds 100%, gain multiple "Inspiration".
    ○ Pure Ultra: If the team consists only of Ultra Awakers, the Ultra Mastery attribute effect is doubled, and the Ultra Turn effect is not halved.
  
【Awaker Enhancements】
● Tulu
    ○ Talent - Divine King's Power: Each point of Aliemus recharge level now grants an additional 5% power bonus to "Strike" and 15% power bonus to "Abyssal Command". The effects of discarding "Strike" and "Defence" no longer require Enlighten 2 to trigger, and the effect of commanding a tentacle to attack when any command card is discarded is transferred to the talent.
    ○ Aliemus Burst - Star Alignment: Adjusted from 76 temporary tentacle damage to 61 temporary tentacle damage and power, effectively increasing temporary tentacle damage by 20%.
    ○ Spiral Return: Adjusted from 61 temporary tentacle damage to 46 temporary tentacle damage and power, effectively increasing temporary tentacle damage by 13%. If the current stance is "Calm Sea", additionally reduce all enemies' power by 48 for this turn.
    ○  Awakening - Immortal Majesty: Tulu gains 4 tentacle damage and power for each point of Arithmetica consumed, effectively increasing temporary tentacle damage by 20%. Now, discarding any of Tulu's command cards also triggers this effect once.
    ○ Enlighten 2 - Touch of Revival: "Strike" and "Defence" also increase Tulu's attack power by 8% temporary power, effectively increasing temporary tentacle damage by 50%.
 
● Lily
    ○ Flower Upon Slime: Poison damage increased by 150%.
    ○ Gnosis Awakening - Slime Gathering: Poison damage increased by 50%.
    ○ Forbidden Swamp: Poison damage increased by 100%.
    ○ Strike to Protect: Poison triggered on crit increased to 100%.
    ○ Enlighten 3 - Never Forget: Endurance gained increased from 5% to 10%.
 
● Sorel
    ○ Dance of Desire: HP recovery effect adjusted to occur at the end of the turn, consistent with Diamond in the Rough.
    ○ Dance of Desire: Infinite Devour effect additionally increases "Dance of Desire" HP recovery by 10 points.
    ○ Beauty of the Rose: HP recovery effect adjusted to occur at the end of the turn, consistent with Diamond in the Rough.
    ○ Enlighten 1 - Floating Stream: Additionally, if current HP is below 50%, base "Defence" grants 2 shields, Embryo Fusion +10%.
 
● Daffodil
    ○ Aliemus Burst - Sea of Essence: Now receives 3x power bonus.
    ○ Thousand Mirage - Arithmetica Cost 0: Additionally causes 50% poison damage.
    ○ Thousand Mirage - Arithmetica Cost 2: Base damage increased by 33%, additionally causes 50% temporary counter damage.
    ○ Thousand Mirage - Arithmetica Cost 4: Base damage increased by 50%.
 
【Wheel of Destiny Enhancements】
● Song of the Divine King: Aliemus gained at the start of battle increased from 16/19/22/25 to 25/30/35/40.
● Crossing Pain: Shield increased from 3.5/4/4.5/5% of max HP to 4/5/6/7%.
● In the Name of the Rose: Embryo Fusion gained when devouring an embryo increased from 11/14/17/20% to 16/19/22/25%.
● Most Precious Collection: Each time the user triggers a Leap effect, the final damage dealt by the user this turn increases by 2/3/4/5%, stacking up to 3 times.
 
【Stages】
● With the defeat of the Primordial Shadow, the recommended level for "Normal Difficulty" stages in chapters 6 to the final chapter of "Operation" has been reduced from 51~70 to 51~60. Enemy HP has been reduced by up to 28%, and enemy damage has been reduced by up to 22%.
● Adjusted the skill "Bone Erosion" of the monster "Sea Walker Guard", increasing its damage and reducing the HP of summoned creatures.
● In "Dream Dive" and "Transcendence", skipping normal battles with muscle memory now reduces HP loss from 30% of max HP to 20% of max HP. Elite battles can now be skipped, but will result in a 40% max HP loss.
 
【Optimizations】
● Optimized "Miryam's" Gnosis Awakening. When placing "Path of Faith" and "End of Faith" in hand, if the hand is full, they are placed in the draw pile instead of being "consumed".
● Optimized the icons for the states "Heir to Delusion" and "Murmur", using a unified damage reduction icon.
● Optimized the descriptions of some Awaker Enlighten effects. Effects related to "Strike" and "Defence" now clearly state that they only apply to "Base Strike" and "Base Defence", consistent with the actual effects.
● Optimized the descriptions of "Endurance", "Sacrifice", and "Dream Guide" states, now clearly stating that these states will carry over to the next battle. Other special states not mentioned are assumed not to carry over, with no impact on actual effects.
● Optimized the descriptions of the Wheel of Destiny "Rewinding Time" and Awaker "Ramona-loop" Aliemus Burst "Converging Paradox" in Traphase, now clearly stating that if such effects are triggered multiple times, they will trace back.
● Optimized the display effect of the gauge interface for 200%-300% S-energy.

4. Comprehensive
【Awakening】
● The following Awakers will have a small chance to appear in their respective "Realm Study" permanent awakenings after the corresponding dates. These previously limited Awakers are still not obtainable through "Prime Paradise."
    ○ Awaker "Tulu": January 27, 9:00.
    ○ Awaker "Lily": February 10, 9:00.
    ○ Awaker "Sorel": February 24, 9:00.
    ○ More limited Awakers may be added to "Realm Study" permanent awakenings with future updates, sharing a combined 0.5% SSR appearance rate.

● The following Wheels of Destiny will have a small chance to appear in the "Rotating Aspect" permanent awakenings after the corresponding dates. These previously limited Wheels of Destiny are still not selectable and cannot be obtained through the "Book of Rotation."
    ○  Wheel of Destiny "Song of the Divine King": January 27, 9:00.
    ○ Wheel of Destiny "Beyond Pain": February 10, 9:00.
    ○ Wheel of Destiny "Name of the Rose": February 24, 9:00.
    ○ More limited Wheels of Destiny may be added to the "Rotating Aspect" awakenings with future updates, sharing a combined 0.5% SSR appearance rate.
● Starting from V2.0, newly released limited characters and Wheels of Destiny will no longer be guaranteed to enter permanent awakenings or have a set rerun time. However, previously released limited characters and Wheels of Destiny will still follow the original plan of entering permanent awakenings roughly one year after their first release. They may still be rerun in the future, increasing players' chances to obtain them.

【Dream Dive】
● Added career rewards for the 15,000~30,000 point range, with a maximum of "Silver" x2700, "Remembrance Feather Pen" x300, "Dissolution Pearl" x15000.
● Scoring rules have been adjusted to adapt to changes in the game system.
    ○ "Rapid Dream Chase" scoring item adjusted to defeating the boss within 11/10/9/8 turns, earning 250/500/750/1000 points.
    ○  "Reality Collection" scoring item adjusted to having 5/6/7/8 relics, earning 250/500/750/1000 points.
    ○  Removed the "Edge of Life and Death" scoring item, no longer requiring death resistance triggers.
    ○  Added "Sleepwalker" scoring item, reducing investigation score by 20% for each use of muscle memory, with multiple triggers multiplying.
● The leaderboard will be subdivided to match new realm team combinations, including Pure Chaos, Pure Deep Sea, Pure Caro, Pure Ultra, Deep Sea Caro, Deep Sea Ultra, Caro Ultra. Scores for Chaos Deep Sea, Chaos Caro, Chaos Ultra realm teams will be included in the Pure Deep Sea, Pure Caro, Pure Ultra leaderboards respectively.

【Traphase】
● Added career rewards for the 1500~3000 point range, with a maximum of "Silver" x2700, "Remembrance Feather Pen" x300, "Dissolution Pearl" x15000.
● During the core topic activation period, all Awakers, Wheels of Destiny, and Keys can be used in Traphase gameplay.

【Gnosis Enhancement】
● All Awakers can undergo the 6th~10th Gnosis Enhancement, each requiring "Pure Primal Gnosis Core" x1 and "Primal Gnosis Core" x1.
● "Pure Gnosis Core Fragments" can be obtained from higher-scoring Regional D-Effect rewards, with 25 fragments exchangeable for one "Pure Primal Gnosis Core" in the "Shop: Sediment Exchange."

【Regional D-Effect】
● Starting from the next Regional D-Effect, a new V-level alert will be added, recommended level 75~79, with training value rewards of 70~90.
● Increased rewards for 330~350 training value, with an additional "Pure Gnosis Core Fragment" x15.
● Added rewards for 355~375 training value, totaling "Black Tribute" x2500, "Golden Rose" x500000.

【Keeper Level】
● Keeper level cap increased to 100.
● Rewards for Keeper levels 91~100 have been added to the manual, with a maximum of "Silver" x3600, "Pure Primal Gnosis Core" x10.
● For Keepers who reached level 90 with overflow experience before the update, their level and experience will be automatically updated after the update.

【Archive】
● Background animations from past character events have been added to the Archive. Keepers can go to the "Archive" event page to set their favorite background animations as dormitory backgrounds.
● To unlock the background animations, players must clear any stage of the corresponding character event and consume "Reality Point" x3.

【Profile】
● Keepers can change their gender in the archive, and the corresponding Keeper avatar version will switch accordingly.
● The first gender change is free, subsequent changes will cost "Silver" x1000.

【Shop】
● "Investigation Exchange" and "No Light Exchange" now allow exchanging for Golden Rose.
● After reaching level 50, Keepers can exchange for "Gnosis Fragments" monthly.
    ○  "Sediment Exchange": 10 per month, each requiring 200 Root Sediment.
    ○  "Investigation Exchange": 5 per month, each requiring 2000 Investigation Badges.
    ○  "No Light Exchange": 5 per month, each requiring 2000 Black Tribute.
    ○ "Deep Dive Exchange": 5 per month, each requiring 2000 Dissolution Pearls.
 
【Convenience Improvements】
● Inventory: Wheel of Destiny capacity increased to 300.
● Decomposition: Added an auto-decompose function for excess SR-level Wheels of Destiny upon awakening in settings.
● Team Lineup: When changing characters, the previous character's Wheel of Destiny and Covenant will be retained.
● Language: Upon first entering the game, a window with all "Language" options will appear for players to choose their preferred language environment. Subsequent adjustments can still be made on the login interface or certain pages.
 
5. Traphase
——Designer Mijiu: In this balance adjustment, we aim to achieve three goals. ① Make each card's appearance more balanced, ② Restore the game pace to a more engaging experience in some situations, ③ Adjust the strength of certain combinations and control effects to give both sides more chances to turn the tide.
 
【Paralysis】
● "Completely Paralyzed" original effect: The first time paralysis is applied each turn, add 1 layer of Completely Paralyzed to the target, permanent and undispellable. At 2 layers, discard all "Strikes" from the target, giving them an equal amount of "Illusions."
● "Completely Paralyzed" new effect: The first time paralysis is applied each turn, add 1 layer of Completely Paralyzed to the target, undispellable. If not in a "Paralysis" state at the end of the turn, remove it. At 2 layers, remove the state and discard all "Strikes" from the target, giving them an equal amount of "Illusions."
 
【Potency】
● The damage, shield, and health recovery boost from Potency now only applies to the Awaker's "Strikes," "Skills," and "Exaltation," no longer affecting the Wheels of Destiny carried by the Awaker.
 
【Tawil】
● All Things Return: Damage reduced from 10 to 8, burst lock reduced from 30 to 25.
 
【Hameln】
● Sorrowful Weak Tone: Damage increased from 6 to 8.
● Astonishing Strong Tone: Damage increased from 30 to 35.
  
【Wheels of Destiny】
● End of the Verse: Only grants 1 layer of "Barrier" after using "Skill" if no barrier is present.
● Hand of Forgetfulness: Slow effect reduced from 2 to 1 layer, but doubles when triggered on the first target each turn.
● Gluttonous Fable: Delayed recovery reduced from 25 to 20.
● Never-ending Performance: Madness deduction requirement and amount reduced from 30 to 20.
● Slumber Under the Glacier: Arithmetica cost reduced from 2 to 1.
● Pure Silver's Beginning: No longer gains reinforcement after other allies die, instead gains 20 shield.
 
VI. Bug Fixes
● Fixed an issue causing increasing memory usage and lag during gameplay.
● Fixed an issue where Awaker "Tawil" carrying Covenant "Medicinal Dream" did not reduce Arithmetica cost after transforming "Understanding All Things."
● Fixed an issue where Awaker "Tawil" did not trigger "Effective Twice" effects after transforming "Understanding All Things."
● Fixed an issue in Traphase mode where Awakers with "Severe Injury" did not correctly halve the shield gained from "Gain Shield Based on Damage" effects.
● Fixed an issue where Awaker "Ramona-loop" had an incorrect talent description using "Ramona-prime."
● Fixed an issue where relic "Chrono Pendulum: Projection" did not specify it only affects "Non-Derivative Command Cards."
● Fixed an issue where Covenant "Vitality Extraction" Silver Key charge effect did not work in non-Caro realms.
● Fixed an issue where Covenant "Vitality Extraction" Silver Key charge effect worked in Caro realms.
● Fixed an issue where switching interfaces sometimes displayed temporary text.
● Fixed an issue in the PC version where some interface shortcut keys (ESC) did not work.
● Fixed an issue in the PC version where audio and video desynced when the game was not the active window, adding options to mute or continue playing.
● Fixed an issue where item backgrounds might not display in the inventory.
● Fixed an issue where the main interface investigation progress displayed incorrectly after clearing Chapter 9 of the investigation operation.
● Fixed an issue in "Traphase" where "Rotten Feast" could not correctly apply Severe Injury when only one ally was alive.
● Fixed an issue in "Traphase" where the "Skill" status description of "Green Stone Throne" was incorrect.
● Fixed an issue in "Traphase" where "Deathmatch" did not correctly apply shield or healing conversion effects.
